### StreamDiffusionMotionProvider { #streamdiffusionmotion-kt-streamdiffusionmotionprovider }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">interface</span> <span class="nc">StreamDiffusionMotionProvider</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/media/video/diffusion/StreamDiffusionMotion/#L22)

Optional renderer-owned backward correspondence. RGBA32F, same size as the source: RG = absolute normalized UV in reference, B = confidence [0,1], A = reactive rejection [0,1]. UV uses the same orientation as sampling the source RTT; pixel centres are (xy+.5)/extent. Confidence zero means unknown/disoccluded. Reject occluded surfaces using depth/object IDs. Implementations may record a target here, reuse it between requests, or return null for unavailable history. No CPU pixels. The returned target must be sampled and transfer-source capable.

### ParticleTracker { #particletracker-kt-particletracker }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">class</span> <span class="nc">ParticleTracker</span> <span class="k">internal</span> <span class="k">constructor</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">tools</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">python</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">String</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">cache</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Path</span><span class="p">)</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/media/video/particletracker/#L110)

Cached offline video processing, intended to be called inside a box's `start { ... }` coroutine. The suspend call owns the Python process: cancellation terminates the wrapper and its inference descendants. Successful runs publish a checksum-validated receipt atomically; failures never become cache hits. Locks share concurrent identical requests across boxes and worktrees.

| Declaration | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [<code class="highlight"><span class="k">suspend</span> <span class="k">fun</span> <span class="nf">track</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">input</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">String</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">options</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">ParticleTrackingOptions</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nc">ParticleTrackingOptions</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">offline</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Boolean</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">false</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">force</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Boolean</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">false</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">ParticleTrackingRun</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/media/video/particletracker/#L116) | Tracks a local video, or returns the identical cached run. `offline` refuses a missing pretrained checkpoint without downloading it. `force` recomputes this key while preserving an existing successful result if inference fails. Logs and provenance are retained in the cache. |
| [<code class="highlight"><span class="k">suspend</span> <span class="k">fun</span> <span class="nf">track</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">input</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">options</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">ParticleTrackingOptions</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nc">ParticleTrackingOptions</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">offline</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Boolean</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">false</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">force</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Boolean</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">false</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">ParticleTrackingRun</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/media/video/particletracker/#L121) | Path overload of `track`. No shell expansion or string-command interpolation is used. |
